scope: All seven Vale Wardens units, Bear/Dorothy/Oliver, requested Vargas and Binx/Binks, plus optional Binx creature battle visuals.
art_status: AI-generated starter art processed to a true native pixel grid. Minor pose/equipment drift may still need manual polish before release.

coordinates.pivots: pixel edge coordinates within frame, not normalized

team_masks.format: RGBA PNG, same dimensions as paired asset
team_masks.coverage: alpha255 marks team pixels, alpha0 marks all others

missing_asset_policy: Look up an ID in assets; if absent use the existing game placeholder. No placeholder PNGs are included.

hero.rangers.bear.appearance: Bearded human ranger commander; original fantasy interpretation.

hero.rangers.dorothy.appearance: Female knight, ivory cloak, chestnut braid; user-directed female knight design.

hero.rangers.oliver.appearance: Male hooded ranger, chestnut hair and blue eyes.

hero.pirates.vargas.appearance: Female corsair knight, steel helmet, short dark hair and green eyes; user-directed.

hero.centaurs_beasts.binx.appearance: Black panther-like cat with four paws, long tail and turquoise team collar; user-directed.
hero.centaurs_beasts.binx.mount_exception: User requires Binx/Binks to be a black panther-like cat; no rider or horse.

notes: The final eight-faction list overrides older ten-faction planning counts in the supplied bible.
Battle hit clips have exactly one recoil frame. The other three cells of their atlas hit row are empty.
All eight hero map directions are supplied explicitly; no runtime mirroring is required.
Dorothy remains a Magic hero with Green Mender despite her female knight appearance.
Vargas remains a Pirates/Saltwind Corsairs Might hero with Powder Master despite her female knight appearance.
Binx/Binks is a black panther-like cat as requested. Extra battle art supplies visuals only, not new combat stats.
At 48px map size, facial details use very few pixels; explicit iris colors are preserved in the hero portraits.
Attack and death GIF previews loop for review. Runtime loop/hold behavior is specified separately in each asset entry.
